tooltips.runAsUser: Whose permissions and record ownership this automation runs with. Defaults to the creator when left empty.
tooltips.scheduling: How often this automation repeats. Shown only when Trigger is Schedule.
tooltips.definition:
What the automation does after it is triggered.

• Bulk — find records, then run actions on each one.
• Flow — connected steps: enter a step → run actions → wait or move on → until a Final step.

Use Builder for forms. JSON is only for advanced edits.
tooltips.tenant: Optional workspace. Leave empty to run across workspaces (e.g. loop every Tenant). When set, every item is forced into that workspace.
tooltips.triggerDebouncePeriod: If many triggers fire quickly (record edits, signals), wait this long and only run once (example: 5 minutes).
tooltips.entityTypeFilter: Only start when the triggering record matches these conditions. Subject entity limits which record types can fire this automation.
tooltips.entityTypeFilterFormula: Optional formula that replaces the visual conditions when filled. Use entity\attribute(...) for the record and $trigger for trigger data.
tooltips.kind: Bulk repeats actions over many records. Flow follows connected steps with waits and joins — better for multi-step journeys on one record.
tooltips.triggerType: What starts a run: manual button, schedule, a record change, or an internal signal.
tooltips.subjectEntityType: Required for Flow automations and for entity-change triggers. Which record type this automation is about.
tooltips.crossTenant: When enabled, this automation reads across ALL tenants instead of being restricted to its own. Only an instance administrator can enable it, and it only takes effect while the Run-as User is an administrator. Leave off unless you explicitly need instance-wide reach.

messages.entityFilterChooseSubject: Choose a subject entity first to load its available fields.
messages.entityFilterEmpty: No conditions. Every matching trigger will start this automation.

messages.recurrenceSimpleHint: Use the calendar controls for common patterns. Advanced is only for raw RFC 5545 text.
messages.recurrenceAdvancedHint: Use one DTSTART line, one or more RRULE lines, and optional EXDATE, RDATE, or EXRULE lines. Advanced rules are saved exactly as entered.
messages.recurrenceAdvancedExamples: Examples: every 45 minutes: RRULE:FREQ=MINUTELY;INTERVAL=45. Last weekday: RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1.
messages.recurrenceSwitchSimple: This schedule uses advanced recurrence parts that the simple form cannot edit. Clear or simplify the text to return.
messages.recurrenceInvalidInterval: Repeat interval must be a positive whole number.
messages.recurrenceInvalidStart: Choose a valid start date and time.
messages.recurrenceInvalidException: Choose a valid exception date and time.
messages.builderToolbarHint: Prefer Builder. Use JSON only if you need raw control.
messages.kindHintBatch: Bulk: phases that run in order. A 'For each record' phase finds records and runs actions on every one. A 'Once per run' phase runs actions a single time after the previous phase finishes.
messages.kindHintMachine: Flow: connected steps for one record. Each step can run actions, wait, or wait for child runs. Connect steps until a Final step.
messages.itemModeHint: All matching = process every record found. First match = stop after one (useful for “find any and act”).
messages.stagesPipelineHint: Phases run in order. Use 'For each record' to run actions on every record found, or 'Once per run' for a single wrap-up action.
messages.stageScopeHint: 'For each record' runs the actions once per record this phase finds. 'Once per run' runs them a single time after the previous phase finishes — useful for summaries.
messages.exportToRunBagHint: When this phase finishes, copy selected keys from a Done item into the run-level data bag (shared with later phases). Leave keys empty to export all public data (report, vars, …).
messages.importRunBagHint: When this phase starts, seed each new item’s payload from the run data bag. Flattened into $payload so object\get($payload, 'report') works. Also available as object\get($payload, '_runBag').
messages.onceActionsHint: Runs a single time after the previous phase finishes. Use $payload._run for totals, successes, and failures.
messages.mapPipelineHint: Choose which records to process, then the actions that run on each one.
messages.mapStepsHint: Each source adds or expands the list of records to process. Start with a Primary source, then Expand through relations if needed.
messages.actionsHint: These run once per record found by this phase. Pick an action — fields appear automatically (no JSON required).
messages.onFailureHint: Optional actions if a main action fails (notify someone, log, etc.).
messages.maxItemsHint: Safety cap on how many records one run may process.
messages.maxExpandHint: Safety cap when expanding children from one parent (e.g. users under a workspace).
messages.initialStateHint: The step where the flow starts. Usually your first “Normal” step.
messages.statesHint: The steps of the flow. Choose a type below — a short guide explains what each type does.
messages.transitionsHint: Connections between steps. After a step finishes, the flow follows a matching connection (optional formula and delay).
messages.mapIdHint: Short name used by later sources (parent) and in run data. Example: t, users, g1.
messages.mapModeHint: Primary starts the list. Expand/loop multiplies records from a parent. Group combines them. Attach keeps records and adds data.
messages.mapSourceHint: Where this source’s records come from: database, a relation, ids, run data, or a report.
messages.mapParentHint: Previous source whose record we expand from. Required for relation / link-multiple sources.
messages.mapRelationHint: Name of the relationship on the parent entity (e.g. users, opportunities).
messages.mapLinkHint: Name of the link-multiple field on the parent (e.g. contacts).
messages.mapPayloadPathHint: Dot path into the record’s run data that holds a list to loop.
messages.mapIdsPathHint: Dot path into run data that holds a list of ids (if not listing ids below).
messages.mapIdsHint: One id per line (or comma-separated). Used when source is “Explicit id list”.
messages.mapReportHint: Id of an Advanced List Report whose rows become records.
messages.mapGroupByHint: Comma-separated fields to group on (e.g. assignedUserId). Used in Group mode.
messages.mapAggregatesHint: What to compute per group: count, sum, avg, min, max, collectIds. Name each result (as).
messages.mapWhereHint: Simple field = value filters (AND). Toggle fx on a value to resolve it from $payload / parent record when records are found. Open Advanced only for complex JSON.
messages.whereAdvancedHint: If filled, replaces the simple filter rows (and their whereFormulas). Must be a JSON object, e.g. {"isActive": true}.
messages.whenFormulaHint: Optional Espo formula (fx). Action runs only when this is true. Leave empty / fixed blank to always run.
messages.mapWhereValueExpressionPlaceholder: Formula value for this filter field
messages.idempotencyHint: true = auto key. Or a template like digest|{targetId}|{type}. Prevents duplicate side effects.
messages.debounceHint: Minimum time before the same idempotency key may run again (e.g. 20 hours).
messages.paramsAdvancedHint: If filled, replaces the form fields above. Power users only.
messages.noParamDefs: This action has no form fields — paste params as JSON or pick another type.
messages.linkExpressionHint: Use fx to resolve this id dynamically from $payload (otherwise pick a record above).
messages.docVarPayload: Per-record data written by record sources, runReport, and setPayload. Use object\get($payload, 'key'). Cross-phase: importRunBag seeds keys + _runBag from AutomationRun.dataBag. 'Once per run' phases also get _run counts and _scope=once.
messages.docVarPayloadRun: Run totals available in 'Once per run' phases: object\get($payload, '_run') → itemCount, doneCount, failedCount.
messages.docVarPayloadRunBag: Cross-phase bag snapshot after importRunBag: object\get($payload, '_runBag'). Same keys may also be flattened onto $payload.
messages.docVarTenantId: Current workspace id for this item.
messages.docVarRunItemId: Id of the current AutomationRunItem ledger row.
messages.docVarPayloadReport: Default path used by runReport (params.as = report).
messages.docVarPayloadReportCount: List report row count / totals.count after runReport.
messages.docVarPayloadVars: Convention: store custom variables under payload.vars via setPayload.
messages.stateIdHint: Unique name used by connections and by the entry step. Example: Start, WaitPayment, Done.
messages.stateTypeHint: What this step does. See the guide under the type dropdown.
messages.stateTypeHelpNormal: Runs “when entering” actions immediately, then follows a connection to the next step. Use for notices, updates, starting children, etc.
messages.stateTypeHelpWait: Pauses the run for a relative duration (e.g. 1 day) or until an absolute datetime, then continues when the timer wakes. Great for reminders, deadlines, and delayed follow-ups.
messages.stateTypeHelpJoin: Pauses until child automations finish (start them earlier with “Start child automation”). Choose all vs any, and a timeout.
messages.stateTypeHelpFinal: Terminal step — the flow stops here. Put closing actions on “when entering” (no further connections needed).
messages.stateTypeExampleNormal: Example: enter “Notify” → send WhatsApp → connect to “Wait”.
messages.stateTypeExampleWait: Example: wait until “2026-08-01 09:00:00” (America/Sao_Paulo), then connect to “FollowUp”. Or wait “2 days”.
messages.stateTypeExampleJoin: Example: after starting two children, wait for “All children must finish”, timeout “2 hours”.
messages.stateTypeExampleFinal: Example: step “Done” type Final with a notify on enter.
messages.stateWaitHint: How long to pause before waking. Examples: 30 minutes, 1 day, 2 weeks.
messages.stateWaitModeHint: Duration = relative delay from now. Until = absolute clock time (or a formula).
messages.stateWaitUntilTzHint: IANA timezone used when “Wait until” has no offset (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo). Ignored for ISO with Z/offset.
messages.stateWaitUntilFormulaHint: Optional formula that returns a datetime (overrides fixed Wait until when set). Example: entity\attribute('closeDate').
messages.stateTimeoutHint: If children are not done by then, the item fails. Example: 2 hours.
messages.joinModeHint: All = every child must complete. Any = first finished child is enough to continue.
messages.onEnterHint: Actions that run when the flow arrives in this step. Add cards below — pick a type and fill fields (not raw JSON).
messages.onExitHint: Optional actions when leaving this step toward the next connection. Same builder as other actions.
messages.transitionWhenHint: Optional fx formula; if empty the connection is always eligible after the step finishes.
messages.definitionStagesRequired: Add at least one phase for Bulk automations.
